decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (15.4 g/t) until about 13:20. Central is truck-limited: loader inflow is 159 t/h against 91 t/h truck capacity. Lending LH-06 from the 5.8 g/t stope costs Central nothing. LH-06 gains about 3 productive hours at Este, where the stockpile has room (170 of 450 t). Net is about +52 oz, and the radio and CMMS agree.
